messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty PAGER fired (P1009) - dedicated-cluster acme_corp-prod - sustained p95 latency > 500ms for 3m, error rate (5xx) up 6%
anna_oncall: acked on pager. I'm on it. starting triage — collecting metrics now (logs, traces, queue depth)
sam_infra: I see a spike in gRPC 429s and worker queue depth on cluster acme_corp-prod-01, nodepool 'dedicated-gpu-v2' - looks like autoscaler didn't kick at threshold
maria_sre: noted. any recent deploys to that cluster? @deploy-bot can you confirm last deploy timestamp for tenant acme_corp-prod?
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: last successful rollout for acme_corp-prod model-routing was 2026-02-26T14:52:12Z by ci/cd (sha: a3c9f2)
anna_oncall: ok no new model push. sharing quick snapshot:
```
# high-level metrics
p95 latency: 682ms
5xx rate: 6.3% (baseline 0.2%)
queued requests: 1.2k
KV cache hit: 38% (norm ~78%)
GPU util: 94% avg on nodepool
```
sam_infra: KV cache drop suggests many cold cache misses — could be cache eviction due to memory pressure or noisy neighbor. I'm going to check pod OOMs and memory metrics
laura_cs: heads-up: acme_corp reported the slowdown via support ticket 5839. They see timeouts in production traffic and some user-facing errors.
maria_sre: adding impact note: affects all production routes for acme_corp-prod (text-gen and chat). Estimated customer error budget burn: high.
anna_oncall: mitigation plan attempt 1: bump reserved capacity on that dedicated tenant pool (hotfix) and enable rollback to fallback model variant with lower memory. Initiating commands now.
sam_infra: running scaling command: `infractl scale nodepool --cluster acme_corp-prod-01 --nodepool dedicated-gpu-v2 --replicas +4` — should give more headroom, may take ~90s per node to join
anna_oncall: while nodes spin up, enabling fallback routing for acme_corp-prod to route heavy requests to quantized-variant-v1 (lower mem/latency)
anna_oncall: patch applied (canary) to 10% traffic to fallback variant. monitoring errors and latency.
maria_sre: watching logs — 5xx is dropping a bit from 6.3% -> 3.1% in the last 40s, p95 trending down to ~420ms
sam_infra: new nodes are joining: 2/4 ready. one node reporting pod eviction events earlier: `kubelet eviction: memory available below pressure threshold` — will investigate underlying VM memory host config after mitigation stable
anna_oncall: can we keep canary at 25% to relieve pressure faster? will push if safe. Also notifying ACME CS. @laura_cs pls update customer with ETA ~10-15m for full mitigation
laura_cs: on it — will message ACME support channel: "We're actively mitigating; temporary routing to quantized model in progress. Next update in 10m."
maria_sre: p95 now ~310ms, 5xx 1.2%. continuing to monitor for regressions in output quality from quantized variant
sam_infra: nodepool scaled to target, all 4 nodes ready. KV cache hit still low but will warm over time. recommending increasing autoscaler sensitivity to prevent regression: propose lowering targetCPU threshold from 70% -> 60% for this tenant pool
anna_oncall: agreed, will create a short-lived override policy for acme_corp-prod to 60% for next 24h. command: `infractl autoscale update --cluster acme_corp-prod-01 --nodepool dedicated-gpu-v2 --target-cpu 60 --expires 24h`
anna_oncall: doing handoff to night on-call in 30m. will keep watch for 1h post-handoff then transition to standard monitoring.
maria_sre: postmortem note: suspected root cause: unexpected memory pressure leading to KV eviction and cache cold starts combined with autoscaler thresholds too loose for bursty tenant traffic. Follow-ups: investigate eviction root cause, autoscaler tuning, warmup strategies for cache, and a telemetry alert specifically for KV hit-rate drop per-tenant.
laura_cs: ACME updated: "Thanks for the quick response — latency returning to normal, will reach out if anomalies recur."
anna_oncall: marking pager resolved in PD once stabilization holds for 15m. current p95 290ms, 5xx 0.5%, queued requests <100.
incident-bot: PagerDuty PAGER resolved (P1009) by anna_oncall at 2026-03-14T03:47:10Z
anna_oncall: filing short interim incident note and assigning follow-ups: @sam_infra (autoscaler tuning), @maria_sre (postmortem + alert), @laura_cs (customer sync). I'll hand off to night shift in 25m, keeping channel open for updates. :thumbsup:
